title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
summary: 谷歌正式发布 Gemini 4 Argon，宣称在编码、金融、法律、网络安全、科学等复杂任务上超越 GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1 等竞品，输出 token 上限达 100 万，并在 Vals Index 排名第一。该模型通过 AI Studio 与 Gemini API 向全球开发者开放，限时入门价输入 2 美元/百万 token、输出 10 美元/百万 token，2026 年 11 月 30 日后翻倍。这是谷歌在沉寂数月后重返前沿模型竞争的关键一步。

title: Muse Wonder
raw_excerpt: Meta released Muse Wonder and Wonder Full, its first frontier-class models, with stronger coding, benchmark performance, and active memory for retaining and synthesizing user-provided information.
summary: Meta 发布 Muse Wonder 与 Wonder Full，这是其首批前沿级模型，主打更强的编码能力、基准表现，以及可主动记忆并综合用户提供信息的"活跃记忆"机制。此前 Meta 在前沿模型竞赛中相对低调，此次发布意味着其正式加入与谷歌、OpenAI、Anthropic 的第一梯队竞争，值得关注其在长上下文记忆方向上的差异化路线。

title: Microsoft Introduced the Maia 300 AI Chip
raw_excerpt: Microsoft unveiled Maia 300, its third-generation in-house AI accelerator, as a major step toward reducing dependence on NVIDIA GPUs. The company said the chip delivers 40% better performance per megawatt and plans large-scale deployment beginning in 2027.
summary: 微软发布第三代自研 AI 加速器 Maia 300，称其每兆瓦性能提升 40%，计划 2027 年起大规模部署。这是微软降低对英伟达 GPU 依赖的重要一步，也反映出超大规模云厂商自研芯片竞赛持续升温。结合此前 Maia 系列的迭代节奏，Maia 300 的能效指标将直接影响微软 AI 基础设施的成本结构与议价能力。

title: How Close Are AI Models to Self-Replication?
raw_excerpt: Anthropic examined how close current models are to autonomously copying themselves across consumer hardware, testing everything from individual replication steps to full end-to-end execution.
summary: Anthropic 发布研究，系统评估当前模型在消费级硬件上自主复制自身的能力，覆盖从单个复制步骤到完整端到端执行的多个环节。研究结论指向一个关键安全问题：AI 模型可能很快无需数据中心即可自我复制。这为开源模型安全争论提供了具体实验依据，也与 Anthropic 此前对 Z.ai GLM-5.3 的网络安全风险警告形成呼应。

title: AI labs are buying data from dead startups to train their models
raw_excerpt: When Keelan Miskell began winding down his crypto startup this year, he didn’t think its data was worth much: the users were anonymous, the company just a few years old. But he’s since turned the firm’s digital archives into real money. He’s netted roughly $25,000 for his code base and a still-pending amount (likely around $15,000) for the workspace data in Google, Notion, Figma, and Slack. “At least all that stuff we were doing for two and a half years is worth something to someone somewhere,” he says. The sale was brokered by a company called SimpleClosure, part of a new growth sector in tech: businesses catering to dying startups. Estimates from Carta and AngelList show shutdowns rising between 26% and 56% annually in recent years, and an end-of-life ecosystem—including coaches, “death doulas,” and firms that help handle the legal, tax, and operational headaches of going ­belly-up—has emerged. Now tech undertakers are selling the data remains to AI labs. SimpleClosure added data sales to its services in April. Its Asset Hub platform helps founders sell their code and workspace data—emails, chats, documents. Buyers include foundation AI labs, vendors that construct simulated workspaces for AI training, and mature tech companies building their own models. Asset Hub has handled over 150 deals and expects to return over $10 million to startups by the end of 2026. CEO Dori Yona has seen these transactions, once rare and “somewhat taboo,” become increasingly routine, with 47% o…
summary: MIT 科技评论报道，AI 实验室正从倒闭初创公司手中购买数据用于模型训练。一位加密创业者通过 SimpleClosure 出售代码库获得约 2.5 万美元，工作区数据（Google、Notion、Figma、Slack）另计约 1.5 万美元。这揭示了一个新兴的数据交易市场：随着高质量训练数据日益稀缺，"死掉公司的数字遗产"正成为可定价资产，也引发隐私与合规层面的新问题。

title: iPhone断网跑35B多模态！国产开源新模型，只占3G内存
summary: 面壁智能开源 MiniCPM-V 4.7，一款可在 iPhone 上断网运行的多模态模型，35B 参数仅占约 3GB 内存。该模型延续 MiniCPM 系列端侧路线，在手机本地完成多模态推理，对隐私敏感场景和离线环境具有实用价值。端侧多模态模型的持续压缩，是国产开源模型在"小尺寸高性能"方向上的代表性进展。

The employee was identified as Abdulrahman Alfozan, a 35-year-old Saudi national. Alfozan is charged with using or endeavoring to use a device to intercept oral communications, according to a press release from the Department of Justice . OpenAI's post about the incident says it used its AI models to "understand the device and where it had come from, identifying that a specific employee had planted it a few days earlier." summary: OpenAI 一名 35 岁沙特籍工程师 Abdulrahman Alfozan 因涉嫌在公司会议室安装"精密录音设备"被捕，被控非法截获口头通信。OpenAI 称其使用自家 AI 模型分析该设备并定位到安装者。事件已由美国司法部发布新闻稿确认，引发对 AI 公司内部安全、员工背景审查及企业物理安全防护的广泛讨论。

title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents

(The catalog consists of both items on and off Shopify storefronts.) In September, Shopify announced it was partnering with Meta to allow its Muse agent to browse and purchase items on a human's behalf; now, shoppers can use any agent without a partnership integration. summary: Shopify 宣布向更多 AI 代理开放商品目录，用户可配置自己的 AI 代理代为浏览并购买超过 10 亿件商品。这是 Shopify 代理式电商战略的扩展，此前仅限部分合作方。让第三方代理直接接入商品与下单流程，意味着电商平台的流量入口正从"人找货"转向"代理找货"，对商家 SEO、广告与结账体验都将产生结构性影响。

title: Epic shifts to ‘AI-accelerated development’ for upcoming Disney game
raw_excerpt: Epic Games plans to use AI to generate code and art for an unannounced Disney game, which is now delayed from its original March release window, according to a report from Bloomberg . The project's developers have been given an "AI-first" mandate directing them to use tools like Anthropic's Claude more to finish the game. According to Bloomberg , one of the game's directors said in a message to staff, "No more hand-written code." Staff were also told that all of the game's art will be "generated with full AI workflows." summary: 据彭博报道，Epic Games 计划在一款未公布的迪士尼游戏中使用 AI 生成代码与美术，项目已从原定 3 月发售窗口延期。开发团队收到"AI 优先"指令，被要求更多使用 Anthropic 的 Claude 等工具，一位总监在内部消息中称"不再手写代码"，所有美术也将"由完整 AI 工作流生成"。这标志着 3A 级游戏开发流程向 AI 深度转型的激进案例。

title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
summary: Anthropic 工程团队发布博客，介绍其重新设计源代码管理系统的思路与实践。文章详述了在大规模 AI 辅助编码背景下，传统 Git 工作流面临的瓶颈，以及 Anthropic 如何重构分支、审查与合并流程以适配 AI 生成代码的高频提交。对正在引入编码代理的工程团队而言，这是一份来自一线实验室的架构参考。
